banner.title: obsidian-livesync
banner.tagline: Runs a single-node CouchDB that the Self-hosted LiveSync plugin syncs Obsidian vaults into, behind a login on the internal gateway.

art.about: a single-node document database that syncs note vaults between devices
art.title: How obsidian-livesync syncs a vault

explainer.title: Vault changes in, one CouchDB store out

steps.title: Login
steps.text: ExternalSecret obsidian-livesync-secret fills the CouchDB user, password and cookie secret from 1Password item obsidian-livesync.
steps.scene: a key emerging from a vault

steps.title: Config
steps.text: ConfigMap obsidian-livesync-config mounts local.ini over the image default: single node, a required login, and CORS for the Obsidian apps.

steps.title: Store
steps.text: CouchDB keeps the vault documents under /opt/couchdb/data on claim obsidian-livesync. Compaction runs at 70 percent fragmentation.
steps.scene: a document stack with a compactor

steps.title: Sync
steps.text: The plugin pushes and pulls document chunks over HTTPS through envoy-internal. Documents up to 50 MB are accepted.
steps.scene: two laptop screens with arrows between them

steps.title: Back up
steps.text: kopiur snapshots the claim to Ceph and R2 as UID and GID 5984, the identity measured from the files.
